subject: POC readiness, owners, and evaluation plan — LumaHealth
body:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Claire Emerson <claire@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC readiness, owners, and evaluation plan — LumaHealth

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the pilot: 

Key pain points you shared
- High latency and cost on current NLU routing for appointment summaries (spikes during peak hours).
- Inconsistent intent detection across short user messages (low recall for reschedules/cancellations).
- Need for tighter auditability and token-level cost visibility for finance.

Pilot goals (what success looks like)
1) Operational: reduce P50 generation latency for summary/intent pipeline to < 300ms for 16-token outputs under expected pilot QPS.
2) Quality: raise intent classification match rate to >= 85% on our 120-sample prompt suite (baseline you provided = 72%).
3) Economics: demonstrate >= 30% reduction in per-month inference cost for the evaluated workload (using our batching + KV-prefix caching recommendations).
4) Compliance: show end-to-end request logging to satisfy internal audit (token-level usage + per-call metadata).

Proposed POC scope (30 days) — high level- Environment: Redwood Dedicated sandbox (isolated GPU pool) with VPC peering to LumaHealth staging account.
- Data: evaluation will use the 120 anonymized prompts you shared + a 2-week live sampling window (read-only ingest for telemetry).
- Models: test against two model variants (redwood-3b-qa and redwood-7b-fast) with recommended quantization profiles.
- Eval: automated scoring on intent match, latency, throughput, and per-token cost. We'll run 3 prompt variations per sample (canonical, noisy, truncated).

Ownership (who does what)
- LumaHealth: Claire Emerson (project lead) — provides prompt set, staging AWS creds (read-only for sample ingest), and procurement contact.
- Redwood: Irene Choi (AM) — program lead and single point of contact; Marissa Cole — solutions engineering and eval setup; Sean Gallagher — onboarding/CS and SLA verification.

Timeline (tentative)
- Day 0 (today–2 days): access checklist + network questionnaire completed (we attached Network_Questions_LumaHealth.xlsx).
- Day 1–3: VPC peering + API key provisioning + test data upload.
- Day 4–10: baseline runs against both model variants; initial eval reports.
- Day 11–20: tuning (prompt edits, batching) and second eval pass.
- Day 21–30: final report, handoff, and optional extended pilot/price discussion.

Access checklist (short)
1) Staging AWS account ID and S3 path for sample upload (read-only cross-account role).
2) CIDR(s) for allowed egress (for VPC peering) or confirmation to use our private Connector.
3) Point person for procurement (we'll send a short SOW + order form).

Attachments included:
- PoC_Scope_v1.pdf — draft scope and acceptance criteria.
- Network_Questions_LumaHealth.xlsx — minimal networking & firewall checklist.

Open items / asks for LumaHealth
- Confirm the three owners above and the staging account details by EOD Friday (June 18).
- Share your procurement contact (email) so we can circulate a short SOW and order form.
- Agree to the proposed success metrics or suggest alternate thresholds.

If that looks good I’ll queue Marissa for the environment build once we have the staging creds.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Claire Emerson <claire@lumahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@lumahealth.com>, procurement@lumahealth.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness, owners, and evaluation plan — LumaHealth

Thanks Irene — this is great and captures everything we discussed. A few notes: 

- Confirmed: I will be the program lead and will own prompt set delivery. Expect the 120-sample set by Friday morning.
- Procurement contact is Raj Patel (cc'd) — Raj, please let us know the preferred PO process and any standard terms you need.
- For networking: we prefer to use VPC peering to our staging account; I'll share the account ID and the S3 path by EOD.

Two small asks: 
1) Can Redwood include a one-page data handling note for our security team that lists what telemetry/metadata is collected during the pilot?
2) We would like the latency metric to be reported as both P50 and P95.

Also — quick question on the evaluation: can you confirm that the noisy/truncated prompt variants will be synthetically generated by Redwood so we don't need to supply extra data?

If you can send the SOW draft, we can loop in procurement and legal.

Best,
Claire
Claire Emerson
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations | LumaHealth
claire@lumahealth.com | +1 617-555-2298
